digest:
- DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, consolidating major last-mile delivery platforms and creating massive gig ecosystems that impact specialized commercial auto risk pools and centralized fleet programs [2].
- AM Best reports that commercial auto liability coverage continues to bear the brunt of rising claims and costs, validating industry-wide pressures that reinforce Nirvana's need for strict telematics underwriting [9].
- High diesel surcharges approaching 30% are driving record delivery fees, squeezing delivery fleet profit margins and heightening their sensitivity to commercial auto insurance pricing [4].
- Slingshot Insurance raised $27 million to expand AI-native embedded insurance infrastructure, increasing competition for MGA software infrastructure and white-label distribution channels [10].
